_about: SINGLE-TRANSLATION SHELF: more one-off English translations of plays and poetry: Gorky's The Lower Depths (Covan, Moscow Art Theatre), Schnitzler's Hands Around (1920), Claudel's Tête-d'Or, Brieux's Three Plays (with Shaw's preface), Echegaray ×2 (The Great Galeoto, The Son of Don Juan), Sardou's The Sorceress, Heijermans's The Good Hope, Cervantes's Numantia, Mitra's Nil Darpan (Madhusudan Dutt, 1861), the Chushingura, Roswitha's plays (Christopher St. John), Mascagni's Cavalleria Rusticana; and verse: Petrarch's sonnets (Higginson), Garcilaso (Wiffen, 1823), Leopardi (Cliffe), Mistral's Mirèio (Harriet Preston), Boiardo's Orlando Innamorato (W. S. Rose), La Fontaine's Fables (Thornbury), Oehlenschläger's Gods of the North, Pushkin's poems (Panin), Arthur Way's Lay of the Nibelung Men, the Orkneyinga Saga, The King's Mirror, the Dean of Lismore's Book, Antar, Abu'l-Ala's Luzumiyat (Rihani), Rumi's Mesnevi (Redhouse), Sadi's Bustān, Iqbal's Secrets of the Self (Nicholson, 1920), the Childers Jātaka, the Diamond Sutra (Gemmell), Sumerian Hymns, Fir-Flower Tablets (Ayscough and Amy Lowell), Diaries of Court Ladies of Old Japan, Halper's Post-Biblical Hebrew Literature, Christine de Pisan's Othea (Scrope) and The Babees' Book. Each title gates on its own translator (_surname_by_slug). US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 43); Adam may veto. No uids minted. Round 120 (2026-10-23, vetoable) added Krylov twice: Ralston's Krilof and His Fables (fourth edition, 1883) and Harrison's Kriloff's Original Fables (1883). Round 121 (2026-10-23, vetoable) added Lermontov's The Demon three times (Stephen 1875, Storr 1894, Burness 1918) and Rudzinsky and Gardiner's Poems selected from Karamzin to Nadson (1917). Round 124 (2026-10-23, vetoable) added Rustaveli's The Man in the Panther's Skin (Marjory Scott Wardrop, 1912). Round 125 (2026-10-23, vetoable) added Werfel twice (Goat Song and Juarez and Maximilian, Ruth Langner, 1926), Toller twice (Masses and Man, 1923, and Brokenbrow, [1926], Vera Mendel) and Georg Kaiser's From Morn to Midnight (Ashley Dukes, 1922).
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.
